definitions.calendar_candidate_enumeration: Every UTC Wednesday date from 2023-03-29 through 2024-12-25 inclusive, with no outcome-driven omissions or additions.
definitions.candidate_name_format: BTCDVOL_USDC-DDMMMYY with English uppercase 3-letter month abbreviation.
definitions.nonexistent_exact_instrument: An exact get_instrument API error indicating instrument not found is a deterministic candidate miss and is not counted as a provider/source technical failure.
definitions.accepted_contract: Exact metadata result whose returned instrument_name equals the requested candidate; kind=future; price_index=btcdvol_usdc; creation_timestamp >= 2023-03-27T00:00:00Z; expiration_timestamp < 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z.
definitions.ordinary_public_trade: A deduplicated exact-instrument historical trade with both block_trade_id and combo_id absent or null.
definitions.active_utc_day: UTC calendar date containing >=1 ordinary public trade for that contract.
definitions.aggregate_active_contract_days: Sum of unique active UTC day counts across confirmed contracts. A date active in two different contracts counts twice because contracts are separate source episodes.
definitions.qualifying_contract: Confirmed contract with >=20 ordinary public trades and >=5 unique active UTC days over its exact listed life.
definitions.calendar_quarter_for_coverage: UTC calendar quarter containing the contract expiration_timestamp.
definitions.core_field_coverage: Across ordinary public trades only: present-and-non-null cells divided by ordinary_trade_count * number_of_required_core_fields.
definitions.aux_field_coverage: Across ordinary public trades only: present-and-non-null cells divided by ordinary_trade_count * number_of_required_aux_fields.
definitions.metadata_integrity_rate: Accepted exact contracts whose returned metadata satisfies all acceptance conditions divided by accepted exact contracts. Nonexistent candidate misses are excluded from this denominator.
definitions.first_last_trade_timestamps: Minimum and maximum timestamp among ordinary public trades for a contract; source coverage metadata only, not an economic outcome.

transport_rules.http_retries: Maximum 3 attempts for 429 or 5xx/network exceptions with deterministic waits 1s, 2s, 4s. Other API errors fail closed except exact instrument-not-found candidate misses.
transport_rules.slice_boundary_validation: Every retained trade timestamp must lie within the exact accepted contract creation-expiration bounds and before 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z; otherwise fail closed.
transport_rules.raw_payload_policy: Do not write raw trade payloads to artifacts. Preserve per-request SHA-256, byte count, bounded timestamps and returned row count only.
transport_rules.economic_value_policy: Trade prices, amounts, directions, index_price values and mark_price values may be inspected only for field presence during source acquisition and must not be written, aggregated, ranked or statistically analyzed.
